name: Mirror Entity
oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
{X}: Until end of turn, creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X and gain all creature types.
blocked_sentences: Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
{X}: Until end of turn, creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X and gain all creature types.

needs.what: A way to say 'is every creature type' (205.3m, the changeling characteristic): as a card's own characteristic-defining static for Changeling, and as a one-shot, until-end-of-turn grant over a selector ('creatures you control ... gain all creature types', e.g. an `add_subtype` op/static flag `all_creature_types: true` with `duration`), which every subtype reader (creature_types_of, printed_creature_types, shares-a-creature-type, subtype filters, tribal cost reductions and triggers) treats as matching every creature type rather than a finite literal list.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: There is no `changeling` keyword in `keywords`. `add_subtype` (op and static) and `animate`'s `subtypes` only grant a literal list, and enums.SUBTYPE_CLASS does not enumerate creature types, so no list is exhaustive; the shipped Avian Changeling template's 30-type `add_subtype` list is an approximation that misses any creature type not on it. The base P/T half is sayable (`animate` with X power/toughness and `duration`), but the card is not complete without the type grant.
